correctness.rationale: For ordinary traces and probability Haar, orthogonality gives the stated S. Independently, Schur–Weyl duality and the hook-length formula give the multiplicities in each tensor power of the fundamental; the three-row partitions are compared after subtracting the last row, because determinant twists disappear on SU(3). Pairing those multiplicities and expanding h=|w|²−1 gives moments 145, 40, 13, 6 and phase moment 22. The center retains only equal exponents or a difference of ±3, giving the full stated polynomial. After dividing by |a|²S², phase alignment minimizes the ratio. The derivative of the aligned ratio has two positive zeros, by the signs at 0, 1/4, 1 and 3 and Descartes' rule. Its unique global minimum is at the first zero, below 75 and below the endpoint at infinity (139). Positivity follows from the negative discriminant of 75−44u+318u². These steps also verify the pure-adjoint sixth-moment maximizer, the three relative phases at nontrivial stability equality, and the cases a=0 and b=0.
